info.title: CS7.1 daemon API
info.description: Private API exposed by cs71d only over /run/cs71/cs71d.sock. HTTP 202 acknowledges durable admission or deduplication; it never means that firmware completed an operation.

200.description: The daemon process is live; controller readiness is not implied.
Current readiness state. A false ready value is still a successful health read.

get.summary: Read the complete immutable machine snapshot

200.description: SSE stream. A stale cursor receives snapshot.required before the stream closes.

post.summary: Verify and connect the configured controller session
Run explicitly confirmed fail-closed session recovery

post.description: This is a software stop, not a physical emergency stop. The wildcard generation requests an attempt despite stale or uncertain state and does not imply success.

post.summary: Home the feeder, sorter, or both
Sort one case to a capability-validated slot

post.description: The daemon rejects this operation as NOT_READY until the firmware feed lifecycle gate is qualified and the active session advertises support.

200.description: A bounded page of operations ordered newest first.

patch.summary: Apply an allow-listed daemon configuration change

BffServiceAuth.description: Authenticates only the local SvelteKit service over the protected Unix socket. Browser credentials are never accepted.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque key scoped to the authenticated BFF identity. Same key and canonical request returns the original result; different content conflicts.

IfMatchGeneration.name: If-Match-Generation
IfMatchGeneration.description: Exact snapshot generation observed by the caller.

StopIfMatchGeneration.name: If-Match-Generation
StopIfMatchGeneration.description: Exact observed generation or * to request a priority stop attempt despite stale or uncertain state.

DeadlineMs.name: X-Deadline-Ms
DeadlineMs.description: Finite remaining execution budget in milliseconds when cs71d receives the request. Daemon policy may impose a lower operation-specific maximum.

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: Last applied daemon event_id. It is unrelated to a firmware protocol request_id.

OperationId.name: operation_id
OperationId.description: Durable daemon operation identifier, never a firmware protocol request_id.

XRequestId.description: Opaque daemon HTTP request correlation identifier for diagnostics.

GenerationEtag.description: Quoted immutable snapshot generation in the form "generation:<n>".

OperationAccepted.description: Durably admitted or deduplicated operation. Firmware completion is not implied.

InternalError.description: Sanitized INTERNAL_ERROR. No machine success is implied.

user_id.description: Opaque SvelteKit attribution; not a daemon authentication credential.

slot.description: The active firmware capability snapshot may impose a lower maximum.

operation_id.description: Durable daemon identity; never a firmware protocol request_id.

trusted_terminal.description: True only after a trusted correlated firmware terminal. SUCCEEDED requires true.

protocol_version.description: Negotiated firmware protocol version, independent of daemon API v1.

ready.description: Verified daemon/session readiness only; not physical safety or homing.

DaemonEventType.description: Extensible v1 event name. Consumers ignore unknown names and reconcile from snapshots when required.

event_id.description: Monotonic daemon SSE cursor; not a protocol request_id.

data.description: Bounded event-type-specific payload. Consumers ignore unknown fields and event types within API v1.

request_id.description: Daemon HTTP diagnostic request identifier, not a firmware protocol request_id.

details.description: Sanitized bounded details; secrets, arbitrary protocol payloads, and raw serial data are forbidden.
